pass_rule.logic: PASS if EITHER condition holds on at least one isoform

mechanism_confirmed_rule: CYP2D6 Spearman rho positive AND CYP2C9 Spearman rho negative, BOTH independently meeting the PASS spearman_abs_threshold
fail_rule: neither pass_rule condition holds on any isoform

partial_correlation_confound_check.frozen_before: any partial-correlation computation in this section
partial_correlation_confound_check.purpose: quantify, via Spearman partial correlation controlling for crippen_logp, whether each Part-3-PASS isoform's charge-pIC50 correlation is attributable to the charge/logP anti-correlation Part 3 identified qualitatively, rather than an independent effect

labels.CONFOUND_DRIVEN: partial |rho| drops below the Part-3 threshold, having cleared it unconditionally -- charge signal attributable to lipophilicity, no case for a charge descriptor on that isoform
labels.SURVIVES: partial |rho| stays >= the Part-3 threshold, same sign as the unconditional value -- charge signal independent of lipophilicity on that isoform
labels.not_applicable: isoform already FAILED Part 3's unconditional bar -- reported for completeness only, not re-adjudicated with either label

a_priori_expectation_stated_before_compu.CYP2D6: SURVIVES -- logP correlation is null, nothing for the confound to act through
a_priori_expectation_stated_before_compu.CYP1A2: genuinely uncertain, could go either way
a_priori_expectation_stated_before_compu.CYP2C9: genuinely uncertain, could go either way
a_priori_expectation_stated_before_compu.CYP3A4: not_applicable -- already FAILED Part 3, reported for completeness only
